title: Search and filters — adoption review
status: Review recorded; extraction not yet shipped

decisions.pattern: One combined search and filter form
decisions.contract: One form owner and one live set of query/date/category controls. One Show events submit applies all choices; Enter uses the same form. A standalone Field needs no two-column Search line wrapper.
decisions.kitHome: Search/filter composition contract and shared HTML specimen
decisions.hostOwns: Matching data, GET routes, query serialization and responsive node placement

decisions.pattern: Scrollable filter panel with pinned actions
decisions.contract: Proposed tide-filter-panel owns an optional header, independently scrolling body and non-scrolling footer. Count, Reset all and full-width submit belong in that footer. Desktop and modal presentations share the shell's inner layout.
decisions.kitHome: Proposed css/filter-panel.css in tide.components.extensions; shared templates/filter-panel.html; all-theme fixtures
decisions.hostOwns: Native aside/dialog host, placement, dimensions, breakpoint, opening/closing and draft snapshot

decisions.pattern: Live draft match count and Show N events
decisions.contract: The panel count previews the draft; the feed count describes applied results. Update one polite atomic draft status without moving focus. The submit label and count agree, including zero and singular wording.
decisions.kitHome: Proposed filter-panel count/status-row elements; existing applied Result summary
decisions.hostOwns: Calculating matches, pluralization, validation and applying results

decisions.pattern: Reset all, Cancel and Clear all
decisions.contract: Reset all edits the draft to empty choices and does not navigate. Modal Cancel/Escape/backdrop restores opening values. Clear all removes applied URL criteria. Closing the desktop rail retains its draft.
decisions.hostOwns: Snapshot, rollback, applied URL, focus restoration and desktop disclosure state

decisions.contract: Reuse quiet/icon Button. Keep an accessible name when the text label is hidden. Expose dialog relationship and expanded state while enhanced. Avoid a new special search-button block.
decisions.hostOwns: Header placement, icon/text breakpoint, applied-state wording and dialog activation

decisions.decision: Reuse Badge, Link and Result summary
decisions.contract: Keep the applied query visible in result wording and the date/category context available after closing the panel. A descriptive category badge is text, not a removable chip or toggle.
decisions.hostOwns: Which criteria are active, count grouping and clear-all destination

decisions.pattern: Invalid dates, one result and no results
decisions.contract: Preserve invalid entries, attach the date explanation to its field and block invalid submission. Zero matches is valid and leads to an Empty state with a recovery link. Month counts and jumps reflect applied matches.
decisions.kitHome: Field/Empty/Calendar integration examples and state matrix
decisions.hostOwns: Date/category rules, hidden cards/groups, recovery URLs and preview selection

decisions.contract: Use native dialog/showModal for the flyout and native details/summary for fallback. Name the dialog, place focus inside it, contain keyboard navigation and restore focus on dismissal. Reuse controls instead of cloning them at breakpoints.
decisions.hostOwns: Dialog lifecycle, native inertness, initial/return focus, snapshot rollback, reduced motion and visual-viewport handling

decisions.pattern: Margin Reveal, panel heights and native scrollbar compensation
decisions.contract: Keep the 75rem breakpoint, wider header margin, fixed detail position, shared viewport fit and 24px plus measured gutter rule in the app shell. A measured browser gutter is runtime geometry, not a theme token.
decisions.hostOwns: All desktop column geometry and native scrollbar measurement/cleanup

states: Clean
All 48 events; Reset all disabled; Show 48 events
Applied feed and URL remain unchanged while editing.
Draft
Query, dates or categories change the preview count
No navigation, automatic submission or feed replacement.
One match
1 matching event; Show 1 event
Correct singular wording in both places.
Zero matches
0 matching events; Show 0 events remains available
Submission uses the existing no-results recovery state.
Invalid range
Check the date range; Check dates
Keep entered values, explain the error and block submission.
Reset draft
Query, dates and categories clear together
Do not use native type=reset when the desired target differs from the form's initial URL values.
Cancel modal
Close, Escape or backdrop restores opening values
Restore the opening snapshot, which may itself be an unsubmitted draft.
Close desktop rail
Hide the rail and retain the draft
Hiding the non-modal rail is not the modal Cancel action.
Apply / Enter
One GET form submits all current choices
Host updates result count, calendar context and preview together.
Clear applied
A real link removes applied criteria
Distinct from Reset all's unsaved draft edit.
Resize
Restore the same live controls in their new host
An open modal rolls back before desktop restoration; no duplicate IDs or submissions.
Refresh / Back
Applied URL and reading context are retained
Host owns history, focus and scroll restoration.
